candidates.name: West-East 1 Pipeline (Jebel Dhanna-Fujairah Crude Oil Pipeline)
candidates.sponsor: ADNOC (Abu Dhabi National Oil Company) / ADNOC Onshore
candidates.from: Jebel Dhanna oil storage terminal, Ruwais, western Abu Dhabi
candidates.to: Fujairah oil terminal, Gulf of Oman coast

evidence.note: Names the project 'West-East 1'; route Habshan/Jebel Dhanna fields to Fujairah; 360+ km, 48-inch; doubles export capacity to bypass Hormuz; targeted operational 2027; announced as part of a Crown Prince-led infrastructure review.
Route Jebel Dhanna (Ruwais)->Fujairah via Habshan; 1.5 mn b/d capacity; distinct second line alongside existing ADCOP (1.8 mn b/d); completion targeted 2027.
GlobalData profile: Jebel Dhanna, Abu Dhabi -> Al Fujayrah, onshore oil pipeline, 520 km, operator ADNOC, listed as an upcoming/under-development project.

Project profile 'ADNOC Onshore - West to East Pipeline (WEP)': 520 km Jebel Dhanna terminal -> Fujairah Port, crossing five emirates, includes storage tanks and pumping stations; sponsor ADNOC Onshore.
'New Fujairah Pipeline': Jebel Dhanna Port Oil Storage Depot -> Fujairah main oil terminal, 500 km, 1.5 mn b/d, ADNOC sponsor, second crude export line complementing ADCOP.

'Dhanna-Fujairah crude oil pipeline', 310 miles (~500 km), $3bn ADNOC investment, reported 50% complete as of May 2026, targeting 2027 completion — confirms active construction, not just an announcement.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Roster's only Habshan-Fujairah line is P0553 (Bab-Habshan-Fujairah Oil Pipeline aka ADCOP, 406 km/48in/1.8mn bpd, operating since 2012). This is a distinct SECOND crude line originating at Jebel Dhanna/Ruwais (not Habshan), ~500-520 km, running parallel to ADCOP to double Fujairah export capacity, under active construction (50% complete May 2026, targeting 2027). It does not match any existing roster PID by route or status (construction vs. P0553's operating) and is not present under any name/aka in the roster. Consolidator should confirm it is not simply a capacity-expansion attribute change to P0553 rather than a standalone new pipeline segment — sources consistently describe it as a separate pipeline/project (WEP) with its own route (Jebel Dhanna start, not Habshan) and its own multi-year construction history dating to at least 2024.
